def: A genus of palms, one species of which produces the areca nut,or betel nut, which is chewed in India with the leaf of the PiperBetle and lime.
An empty tomb or a monument erected in honor of a person who isburied elsewhere. Dryden.A cenotaph in Westminster Abbey. Macaulay.
Set or turned back to back.
The act or process of refining gold or silver, etc., in acupel.
To lie snug or quiet. [Obs.] Herbert.
To praise greatly or extravagantly. Goldsmith.
Rough dressing by knocking off knobs or projections; knobbing.
A tool for forming the necks of bottles, etc.
